context.body: Abram is told to leave, is promised a great nation and name, and is told that all families of the earth will be blessed in him.

observations.body: The passage uses promise and blessing language that later New Testament texts explicitly return to when discussing Abraham and covenant.
observations.label: Blessing begins to move through Abram: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps One household → outward blessing visible within its covenant claim.

payload.posture: Read Genesis 12:1–3 as its own abraham covenant setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places One household → outward blessing inside this covenant setting without turning it into a definition for every covenant passage.
